771000101.text: ...The formula is perfect. I'm sure Grand Duke Alvis will praise the results of my hard work over the last few days upon his return.

771000102.text: Let's... Let's rest here for a little while. Whew...

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Eye of Graeae

771000201.text: It's so cold out there... The train's definitely much cozier...

771000202.text: That is precisely why the trains exist. Trekking long distances through such bitter cold would hardly be good for anyone's health.

771000203.text: Perhaps that, too, was my creator's original purpose in establishing it... After all, this land of ice and snow is hardly a place fit for humans to survive.

771000204.text: Your creator...? Ah, could that be the strange woman we ran into earlier?

771000205.text: How rude! What do you mean, "strange woman"!?

771000206.text: Paimon definitely doesn't mean the strange woman you're talking about right now!

771000207.text: ...You know, the one who appeared in that mumbly-jumbly town with the firebird, and in that castle full of Snegovik. Paimon remembers her name was Ak...

771000208.text: Miss Aksinya, yes. Judging from the memories I have recovered so far, she was once a member of the Belyi Tsar's research organization, the Aly{RUBY#[S]Hvergelmir}pium...

771000209.text: She created me so that I might... guide a certain mighty power, and create a "Tomorrow" — a world where no one would ever suffer again...

771000210.text: A land that has cast aside envy, hatred, and selfish desire. A "Courtyard of Carefree Light" held aloft by the hands of all living beings. Thus...

771000211.text: "Thus shall a radiant world descend, where there will be no distinction between human and human, nor between human and god."

771000212.text: A world where there's no distinction between humans and gods? Hmm... Paimon can't even imagine how you'd make that happen...

771000213.text: "A pure world of mankind, where gods need not wield divine power, and humans need not rely on gods."

771000214.text: ...That is the outcome of the plan, as I remember it.

771000215.text: But as for how it was to be accomplished... I'm sorry, but I do not know the full scope of the final plan. To the plan as a whole, I was nothing more than a "tool" within it.

771000216.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! Goggles is like a crafting bench. It can craft all kinds of amazing things, but a crafting bench doesn't run around eating up its own materials.

771000217.text: That is a very apt analogy. However, if I may, Miss Paimon, in present-day Snezhnaya, alchemy is not an officially supported field of study...

771000218.text: R-Right... But, well, we're on our own train, so...

771000219.text: ...But should I truly seek out the final power?

771000220.text: What if, after obtaining that last portion of power, the memories that return are not the ones I wished to recover? What should I do then?

771000221.text: What if... What if that's the only reason I was created, the purpose I was destined for...?

771000223.text: Yeah! It's definitely not good to decide when you don't know anything yet. No matter what, you've gotta remember everything first!

771000227.text: Anyway... Goggles has helped us out a lot! Even if that wasn't what Goggles was originally created for, Goggles has still been really useful to us!

771000228.text: When that time comes, just come back to us.

771000230.text: Besides, we already talked about all the things we're going to do together when you get your body back! Warming up by the fire, having snowball fights, running around on the ice fields... We promised!

771000231.text: Yes. I look forward to... adventuring together with you both after I recover my body.

771000232.text: Though I have thought this countless times throughout our journey... I am truly glad that you were the one to bring me out of that place, and that I was able to meet you both.

771000233.text: The final power... all the answers are there. At the final resting place of the previous Tsar of Ice — the one known as the Belyi Tsar...

771000234.text: I have marked the location on your map.

771000225.text: Exactly! And if anyone's to blame, it's whoever misused the crafting bench!

771000226.text: Wah, this is all your fault... Now Paimon can't stop imagining a crafting bench going "huff, huff" like some kind of dog!

771000401.text: Friends, we were created for a single moment, \nTo call back those dreams flickering on the verge of extinction, to...

771000422.text: (Wait... wasn't I just... on the train?)

771000403.text: Izmaylo... Izmaylo. Hah, spacing out again, are we? We need to keep watch on the thing inside the egg at all times, remember?

771000404.text: I wasn't spacing out... And the Proto-Man is in a highly stable state. Even in the gloom of the Font of the Shadow Realm, he shines as brilliantly as a pearl.

771000405.text: Then you weren't spacing out. You were worried.

771000406.text: You are right, Azazel. There is too much to think about.

771000407.text: There is no need for such concern. Your teacher, Miss Aksinya, remained quite composed upon hearing of His Majesty the Tsar's passing... Oh, are you worried about something else?

771000408.text: The newly ascended Tsaritsa. It is her attitude that concerns me...

771000409.text: Her attitude toward those fae nobles wallowing in Mora and decadence? I doubt it's anything favorable.

771000410.text: I mean her attitude toward the Alypium...

771000411.text: After all, our research has crossed into forbidden territory. The only reason we were allowed to continue before was His Majesty's tacit approval and protection. But our new Tsaritsa...

771000414.text: They're planning to ban anything related to alchemy. The Alypium has plenty of bio-alchemy projects, so it's obvious those would be shut down. And if that happens...

771000415.text: His Majesty's final aspiration will never be realized.

771000416.text: Perhaps that would be for the best. Have you forgotten what happened during the last experiment? And besides, His Majesty, in the end, also... Never mind...

771000417.text: ...You are right, Azazel. But I still need to think this through.

771000418.text: Don't dwell on it, Izmaylo. It's not our call to make. Besides... the higher-ups are meeting today.

771000419.text: Once they've decided what to do, they'll inform us.

771000423.text: (Is this... a Shadow Realm? Paimon and the Eye of Graeae are gone...)

771000424.text: (...There are two people up ahead. Maybe I should try talking to them.)

771000426.text: Something wrong, my dear Izmaylo? You'd be even better company if you didn't get distracted so easily.

771000427.text: *sigh* I keep feeling like someone's watching us... But when I look back, there's no one there.

771000428.text: Haha, Izmaylo. Maybe you should keep your eyes on what matters.

771000429.text: Speaking of which, Mr. Koshchei seems to have left in a hurry and forgotten to close his office door. Well, never mind. Once we're done recording the data, I'll close it for him.

771000430.text: (They can't see me... That's strange. Something feels off, like I don't quite belong here.)

771000431.text: (But I'm not feeling too uncomfortable. Hmm... Maybe I should take a look around first...)

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the place that the Eye of Graeae showed you

771000302.text: (It looks like it's starving... But according to what Pavlina said earlier, it won't eat unless the food is placed in its bowl...)

771000303.text: (Too bad. There doesn't seem to be a food bowl nearby...)

Find a path into the mountains

771000601.text: ...The formula is perfect. I'm sure Grand Duke Alvis will praise the results of my hard work over the last few days upon his return.

771000602.text: Let's... Let's rest here for a little while. Whew...

771000603.text: (The door's shut... If I can find some way to...)

771000606.text: (All right, all right. Let's get you fed first, poor thing...)

subQuests.subQuestName: Advance into the snowstorm

771000702.text: Yes. That's where we're going... The Belyi Tsar's private palace outside Snezhnograd.

771000704.text: There, the graceful Snegurochka once played the gusli in the palace royal hall, while waterborn fae sang along to the ethereal melody, chanting the name of the king who ruled the snowfields.

771000705.text: Valiant beasts clashed endlessly before the throne, vying for the Tsar's favor, while domovoy searched far and wide for rare treasures and riches, all to fill the palace vault.

771000707.text: Yes. Though by now, I'm afraid it has long since been emptied.

771000708.text: They say... that was where the great king showed mercy. There, he accepted humankind and allowed them to come before him...

771000709.text: To help the frail, pitiful humans of that time carve out a place of their own amid the ice and snow, the flame of Kresnik was first kindled in that palace, then spread far and wide.

771000710.text: And so, unlike in the days of the Pale Star's royal court, this eternally frozen land no longer belonged to the fae alone. It became a land shared by humans and fae...

771000712.text: Oh... So that's how Snezhnaya came to be. Paimon always thought the Tsaritsa founded it...

771000713.text: Hmm, how does Goggles know so much about this place?

771000714.text: Of course. I was created here, in a hidden chamber within this palace...

771000715.text: The place we mentioned before, the Alypium... Though even that is only one corner of the palace's shadow.

771000716.text: Oh, wow... If this palace was so impressive, why does it feel so cold and deserted now?

771000717.text: Because five hundred years ago, the Belyi Tsar died fighting the Abyss and the tides of beasts. His remains were brought back here...

771000718.text: And after he was laid to rest, part of his body became the "White Birch Tsar." Since then, the Tsaritsa has ruled Snezhnaya from Zapolyarny Palace, and no one has returned here since.

771000719.text: So... where we're going is actually the Belyi Tsar's... tomb?

771000720.text: Yes, Miss Paimon. The Belyi Tsar's tomb — but also the place where I was created.

771000723.text: ...The authorities advise against entering without permission. But officially, it is not strictly forbidden.

771000724.text: Not strictly forbidden? Then that means we're strictly allowed to sneak in!

771000725.text: Then again... getting put on a wanted list could be interesting.

771000726.text: Whoa, no thanks... Okay, Paimon knows what to do. If we get caught by some Snezhnayan guards...

771000727.text: Paimon will just say the guiding mechanism sent us the wrong way and we got lost! Getting lost isn't illegal, right? Yep, that's our story.

771000728.text: But... the train tracks are broken. What are we gonna do?

771000729.text: It's all right. That route was only ever meant to mislead people. It was never the real way into the Pale Crown Palace.

771000730.text: Think of it as a marker, telling ordinary pilgrims and those visiting in remembrance that they should go no farther.

771000731.text: If we really mean to cross over, we'll need to find... the mechanism that activates the "hidden tracks."

771000732.text: I can sense it. The mechanism that summons the "hidden tracks" should be up on that tower.

771000733.text: But the tower appears to be encircled by the "White Birch Tsar." We'll have to find another way in...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find the mechanism for the "hidden tracks"
Find the mechanism for the "hidden tracks"

771000801.text: Whoa... Paimon had no idea all this was underneath that giant tree...

771000803.text: That's odd... Why, all of a sudden...

771000805.text: I told you before... that I could sense the power that once belonged to me had been split into three parts. One of them was hidden away in a deeper darkness beyond my perception.

771000806.text: But now, maybe because we're closer, I can feel it... The power I couldn't sense before is right here...

771000808.text: Yes. It is right here... within the Pale Crown Palace before us...

771000810.text: Yes. It is the Belyi Tsar's private palace outside Snezhnograd.

subQuests.subQuestName: Summon the "hidden tracks"

771000901.text: Goggles, you're amazing! Is there any train you can't drive?

771000902.text: ...Not exactly. For some reason, the trains currently running in Snezhnaya only keep their power systems, leaving no room for remote control.

771000903.text: These early prototypes, though, still have control interfaces...

771000905.text: (Strange... Why is Paimon speaking so slowly...?)

subQuests.subQuestName: Wait for the train to approach

771001101.text: (A giant egg... in the middle of the Shadow Realm...)

771001102.text: (Is something inside it? Could that be the "Proto-Man" they mentioned earlier?)

subQuests.subQuestName: Board the train
Enter the strange space
Investigate the strange space

771001301.text: (A note, written in an elegant hand...)

771001302.text: "I will be returning to the House of Hesperides for the next few days, so I'll leave the cat in your care. I can hardly trust the others with her, given how absorbed they become in their experiments."

771001303.text: "I am sure my colleague Koshchei shares my respect for living things and will remember to feed my Lala... The key and specially prepared cat food are on your shelf."

771001305.text: "...And remember, my Lala only eats from her bowl. Please don't scatter her food on the floor. She won't eat anything off the floor."

771001304.text: "P.S. If I find that my cat has not been properly fed, or that she has somehow grown parts from another animal, I will find out who is responsible. — Pavlina"

subQuests.subQuestName: Investigate the strange space
Investigate the next room
Read the notes sealed in Prime Ice

771001401.text: (A note, written in a cold, stiff hand with almost no variation...)

771001402.text: "...The prisoners used as experimental material have already been handed over to Alvis. There is no doubt that the results of that experiment were 'incorrect.'"

771001403.text: "But is that what humans... Is that what loveless fae should seek as 'love'? Perhaps the Snegovik, incomplete in spirit as they are, truly could make use of this technology..."

771001404.text: "To gain the 'love' they lacked from the beginning. Just as... just as 'he' told me, dreams that are too grand have no meaning. Perhaps..."

771001405.text: "Perhaps 'he' was right. That power... That power should have been ours from the start, as compensation. It was never meant to belong to Aksinya's aberrant dream."

771001406.text: "...I will stop here before Alvis 'accidentally' comes across this again and causes more trouble."

subQuests.subQuestName: Find the source of the cat cries
Find a way out of the room
Find a way out of the room

771001501.text: (A set of scales... There's a feather on the left pan, and something is supposed to go on the right...)

771001502.text: (This looks like some kind of ritual. The feather is probably just there to represent something "as light as nothing." What matters is the right side... Something real, but with the same weight as "nothing.")

771001538.text: (This liquid is giving off a strange glow...)

771001517.text: (No, this shouldn't be on the other side of the scales.)

771001539.text: (The keen edge of metal isn't what this question calls for, either.)

771001540.text: (Paper is of the same sort as a feather, but clearly, that isn't the answer the owner of this device is looking for...)

771001541.text: (A vessel with nothing inside... But the vessel itself still has mass.)

771001542.text: (Kresnik Kristall. It appears to have considerable weight.)

771001543.text: (A yellow crystal. It gives off a faint, acrid smell... like rotten eggs?)

subQuests.subQuestName: Leave
Try opening the door in front of the staircase

771002101.text: Ah, my concoction... You naughty little cat, honestly... *sigh*

771002102.text: Great. Now I have to prepare it all over again!

subQuests.subQuestName: Try opening the door in front of the staircase

771001001.text: (Ah, the potion bottle next to me...)

771001004.text: (Sorry about that. Oh, but the door opened. I should go take a look...)

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the second floor and search

771001601.text: They'll be absolutely stunned to learn that I can upload your consciousness here, fully intact, using ancient Hyperborean technology.

771001602.text: Impressive technology indeed. Very well. Let's call this lightweight, portable device the "Eye of Graeae."

771001603.text: ...That's what these goggles are called? But they're blue... Uh, anyway, this feels really weird. I can't feel my arms or legs at all.

771001604.text: Now that I'm inside this tiny little device, I can barely feel... my own body.

771001605.text: (Is that Aksinya... from the past? And the one speaking to her is... the Eye of Graeae from the past?)

771001606.text: That's to be expected. Your consciousness may have been uploaded into these goggles, but your body is still what sustains your power and your existence.

771001607.text: After all, your body is the true key to opening the new world.

771001608.text: As that "key," you are already a perfect work of creation. If only... if only we could have gone further...

771001609.text: But His Majesty... What a pity.

771001610.text: Part of my body once belonged to His Majesty. Sometimes, through fragments of his consciousness, I can see what he once saw. That's how I know...

771001611.text: If all goes smoothly, you will carry on his will and bring his grand design to completion... He would surely be pleased.

771001612.text: "Only you can make me laugh so freely, Aksinya." That's what he would say, and he would mean every word. Not like when he speaks to that "Professor," with all those hollow pleasantries.

771001613.text: A "Royal Jester" gives everything to bring joy to her lord. That is her duty.

771001614.text: "Royal Jester" was merely a nominal title His Majesty gave you so you could come and go from the palace. It was only meant to keep people from resenting a human for being in His favor. You don't have to...

771001615.text: I don't see anything wrong with the title. There's nothing laughable about it. Even now, it still has its uses.

771001616.text: Perhaps I could use it to gain entry to Zapolyarny Palace and speak with the newly crowned Tsaritsa... Though by the time I came to court, she had long since departed...

771001617.text: Perhaps she will understand His Majesty's will...

771001619.text: I should show you to my colleagues, just as you are now. Perhaps then, they'll admit that every line of research has its worth. At the very least, Alvis will stand by me.

771001620.text: Perhaps they will help me carry this great cause forward...

771001621.text: Though I know our ideals do not align, all differences will ultimately return to a single path. In the end, true understanding will come.

771001622.text: They will help me, won't they?

771001626.text: This is the only thing I can do for him, and the only meaning my life has ever had.

771001627.text: I must have the "Proto-Man," have "you"... No, I beg "you." Please, take the place His Majesty was meant to hold in the original plan...

771001628.text: Please, become the ruler of this planet.

771001629.text: Ah... For a grand undertaking like this, why should I need anyone else's approval or support? Maybe I can carry on the final experiment on my own...

771001631.text: A grand vision, yes. But then what?

771001632.text: No... How could you...? Can't you see...?

771001633.text: This is... such a terrible betrayal... Alvis, Koshchei, Pavlina...

771001634.text: You've forgotten... why we came here. Forgotten that grand, radiant vision...

771001635.text: You’ve forgotten... the grace he gave us, the glory he granted us. You...

771001636.text: You cast me out, but no matter. I will return... no matter how long I have to spend in that Shadow Realm beyond beginning and end.

771001637.text: I cannot understand. Why... why would you destroy the grand undertaking we were meant to build, just for your own selfish reasons? Why would you turn away from the path we were meant to follow?

771001638.text:
...This cannot be how it all ends. 
"Even now, I don't hate them. I just feel sorry for them." 
You hear someone say this. At some point, she has appeared, watching her past self fall into shadow. 
"But everything will get back on the right path eventually. Like light passing through different mediums — it may look like it's taking a crooked path, but in truth, it's always taking the fastest, best one."

771001639.text:
...Have you forgotten, friends? We were created for a single moment, 
To call back those dreams flickering on the verge of extinction, 
To let the phantom-like children of daylight lead us into "Tomorrow," 
Where we would laugh and spin, circling the sole seat upon the court of the stars, and build—

771001640.text: Build a pure nation, a homeland born from everyone's love. \nBuild what would become— \nA carefree courtyard for humanity alone.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Paimon

771001702.text: You sat down, and then just froze up all of a sudden...

771001703.text: I did sense a slight disturbance in your mind, but your physical readings didn't change at all...

771001704.text: (You tell them about what you saw in the Shadow Realm...)

771001705.text: ...There have been experimental reports of certain Shadow Realms affecting only the mind, while leaving the body in the "Physical Plane" untouched.

771001706.text: But such cases are exceedingly rare.

771001707.text: #{NICKNAME} is always seeing weird stuff out of nowhere!

771001708.text: ...So, you saw that... place or whatever from five hundred years ago?

771001710.text: You saw the Alypium from five hundred years ago, and Goggles from the past, too!

771001711.text: #So, Goggles, does any of what {NICKNAME} saw sound familiar?

771001712.text: ...My apologies. I do not remember much of what happened back then.

771001713.text: I cannot even clearly recall... that such an argument, or such a conversation, took place before I entered the Shadow Realm.

771001715.text: But that means we can confirm Goggles really did have a body before, right?

771001716.text: #Yes. Based on what {NICKNAME} heard in that conversation... that does put me much more at ease.

771001717.text: Maybe Goggles' body is still somewhere in the center of the Alypium, just waiting for him!

771001720.text: Th-Then the last piece must be in the center of the Alypium...

771001721.text: I hope so. Then I may be able to remember more... and return to my original body sooner.

771001722.text: We will soon be arriving at the Pale Crown Palace. Please be mindful of any jolts as we pull in.

771001723.text: No problem! Paimon's always floating, so a few bumps won't scare Paimon!

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the snow-covered palace
Additional

771001202.text: Stop staring at nothing. We still have a lot to do...

771009001.text: (So this really is the key... Whew, guess we can finally get out of this room now.)

771009002.text: (Hmm... Alvis... Why does that name sound familiar?)
